name: What materials are commonly used for walk-in shower walls and floors?

mainEntity.name: What materials are commonly used for walk-in shower walls and floors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common materials for walk-in shower walls include ceramic, porcelain, and natural stone tiles, as well as solid surface panels. For shower floors, smaller tiles with more grout lines are often used to create better traction, or a custom-sloped shower pan can be installed. When choosing materials, consider their water resistance, durability, and ease of cleaning, as these are practical tradeoffs affecting both aesthetics and long-term performance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common materials include ceramic, porcelain, and natural stone tiles for walls, and smaller tiles or custom pans for floors. Consider water resistance and durability.
